nodes.title: ★ 说明 · Flux 迭代转头：为什么不一步转到 90°、本次要回答什么
widgets_values:
【闻灯 · Flux 迭代转头 —— 第一步：3/4 侧 denoise 阶梯】

★★ 先说结论：为什么不能一步转到 90°
    「闻灯-Flux脸部三视角.json」用 denoise 0.60 从正面基图直接转左侧面/右侧面，
    结果是**两张仍然是大正面**。这不是参数没调好，而是这条路本身不通：
      · denoise 低 → 正面 latent 结构把构图锚死，头根本不动
      · denoise 高 → 结构松了，但 Flux 自带的"美容抛光"先验接管，身份和质感一起丢
    SDXL 也一样（denoise 0.86 只到 3/4 侧）→ 约束文件裁决 B.4 已被否证，见 B.6。

★ 本版改用「迭代转头」：分步小角度转
    正面 →(转 45°)→ 3/4 侧 →(继续转 45°)→ 90° 侧脸
    每一步只让模型改一点点，denoise 就能压得低，身份守得住。

★★ 本次要回答的问题只有一个：**45° 到底需要多大 denoise。**
    所以左侧跑三档：0.55 / 0.70 / 0.85，右侧先跑一档 0.70 做对照。

★ 跑法（只跑草稿，最省时间）
    单张草稿 = 28 步第一段，约 30 秒；四张约 2–3 分钟。
    选定档位后再走「成品」分支（4x 放大 + 二次重绘 0.25）。
    命令：python _scripts\run_wf.py "闻灯-Flux脸部三视角-迭代转头.json" "四分之三左侧-d070" draft

★ 看图时的判断标准（按重要性排序）
    ① 头有没有真的转过去；② 转过去之后还是不是同一个人（看眉骨、鼻梁、单个痣）；
    ③ 皮肤有没有开始变塑料（denoise 越高越明显）。
    ★ 取「转得动的最小 denoise」，不是取转得最狠的那档。

【参数】
    底模      FLUX1\flux1-dev-fp8.safetensors（一体化 fp8，无需另配 VAE/文本编码器）
    采样      euler + simple，第一段 28 步 / 第二段 18 步
    cfg       **必须 1.0**（套 SDXL 的 10 会直接炸图）
    guidance  FluxGuidance 3.5
    分辨率    1024x1280
    seed      固定 20260917（四个分支同 seed，唯一变量是 denoise）
    基图      wendeng_v23_face_base.png = v23 脸部正面成品（身份已锁定）

⚠️ FLUX 在 cfg=1.0 下**没有负向通道**，节点里那条负向接上去也不生效（留空仅为满足接口）。
   「不要磨皮」只能在正向里写成 "no beauty retouching / no airbrushing" 这类否定式短语。

widgets_values: Photorealistic studio headshot of a 24-year-old East Asian man with a masculine face, a strong angular jaw, thick dark eyebrows, deep-set dark eyes with faint shadows underneath, light stubble, and a single small beauty mark at the outer corner of one eye. His head is turned roughly 45 degrees to his left, a three-quarter view. The camera sees the left side of his face much more than the right: his left eye sits near the middle of the frame, the right eye is pushed out toward the far contour of his cheek, the nose is foreshortened with the far nostril wing hidden, and the far cheekbone and far jawline still just show along the edge of his face. He wears a faded blue collared shirt with a dark worn coat collar. His hair is messy wavy black hair, unkempt and slightly damp, with dry individual strands lifting away and separating, and a few loose strands falling across the forehead. It is completely unstyled and there is no hair product, no gel, no salon styling. This is a raw unretouched documentary photograph. Real human skin with clearly visible pores and fine peach fuzz, subtle unevenness in skin tone, faint freckles and a scattering of small moles across the cheeks, natural creases under the eyes. No beauty retouching, no airbrushing, no skin smoothing, not a glamour shot, not a dermatology advertisement. Studio lighting that is soft and even overall but keeps a gentle directional key from one side, so the face still has modeling and depth instead of completely flat light. Plain pure white seamless background, no props, no other people, no scenery, no furniture. Sharp focus, shot on an 85mm lens at f/4, photorealistic, high detail. Keep exactly the same person, the same face, the same hair, the same lighting and the same pure white background as the input photograph — only the direction his head is turned changes.
